translationRepairs: In the second year, Marquis of Ping of Wu Xiao Jing became regional inspector of South Yanzhou and took Ziye on as recorder for the Champion General; when the headquarters was transferred, the appointment ended.

In the second year, Marquis of Wuping Xiao Jing became regional inspector of South Yanzhou and took Ziye on as recorder for the Champion General; when the headquarters was transferred, the appointment ended.
s0020 吳平侯蕭景 titles Xiao Jing 吳平侯, the Marquis of Wuping (place-name Wuping + hou), not 'Marquis of Ping of Wu'; the proposed idiomatic corrects that parsing error.
At that time Marquis of Ping of Wu Xiao Mai and Zhang Zuan of Fanyang, whenever they discussed the classics and histories, would all defer to Ziye's judgment.
At that time Marquis of Wuping Xiao Mai and Zhang Zuan of Fanyang, whenever they discussed the classics and histories, would all defer to Ziye's judgment.
s0053 吳平侯蕭勱 likewise uses the title 吳平侯 for Xiao Mai; 'Marquis of Ping of Wu' misparses the fief name, and Marquis of Wuping is the accurate rendering.
His grandfather Xu Pingdao had been regional inspector of Hailing under the Song.
His grandfather Xu Pingdao had been governor of Hailing under the Song.
s0129 宋海陵太守 names Pingdao 海陵太守 (commandery governor); 太守 is not 刺史, so replacing 'regional inspector' with 'governor' is required.
His grandfather Pingdao was regional inspector of Hailing under Song.
His grandfather Pingdao was governor of Hailing under Song.
s0129 宋海陵太守 has the same office term in the literal field; 'regional inspector' wrongly equates 太守 with 刺史, and 'governor of Hailing' restores the correct office.
In modeling oneself on Ziyou and Zizhang, following in the footsteps of Yan Hui and Zigong, and combining literary talent with moral conduct — all of this we see in Pei Jiyuan.
In modeling oneself on Ziyou and Zixia, following in the footsteps of Yan Hui and Min Ziqian, and combining literary talent with moral conduct — all of this we see in Pei Jiyuan.
s0201 憲章游、夏，祖述回、騫 pairs 游/夏 as Ziyou and Zixia and 回/騫 as Yan Hui and Min Ziqian; the before text invents Zizhang and Zigong, and the proposed idiomatic matches the Chinese and the correct literal.
